title: Why Logical Appeals Don't Raise Money
actionable_recommendations: Lead with emotion in fundraising appeals
Use simple language and clear calls to action
Provide specific outcomes to bolster donor confidence
claims_requiring_current_verification: Outcomes depend on nonprofit’s readiness and unique situation
Success is not guaranteed despite proven strategies
$20K–$100K can be raised in about 90 days
intended_organization_or_user: Small nonprofits seeking to improve fundraising efforts
major_ideas: Donors make emotional decisions justified by logic.
Effective fundraising focuses on individuals rather than programs.
proposed_workflow: Identify a compelling story to highlight
Simplify the message to focus on one program
Incorporate social proof to reduce donor risk
Follow up promptly with personalized thanks and evidence of impact
tools_templates_resources: Coaching tools available in the fundraising fastrack program
